scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @monorepo/config build && pnpm --filter @monorepo/constants build && pnpm --filter @monorepo/contracts build && pnpm --filter @monorepo/database build && pnpm --filter @monorepo/queues build
scripts.watch:packages: concurrently -n config,constants,contracts,database,queues -c yellow,magenta,cyan,red,white "pnpm --filter @monorepo/config watch" "pnpm --filter @monorepo/constants watch" "pnpm --filter @monorepo/contracts watch" "pnpm --filter @monorepo/database watch" "pnpm --filter @monorepo/queues watch"
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && concurrently -n packages,web,api -c yellow,blue,green "pnpm run watch:packages" "pnpm --filter web dev" "pnpm --filter api dev"
scripts.dev:web: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter web dev
scripts.dev:api: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter api dev
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter api build
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/web/build apps/web/.react-router apps/api/dist packages/config/dist packages/constants/dist packages/contracts/dist packages/database/dist packages/queues/dist packages/queues/.tsbuild
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "pnpm --filter web start" "pnpm --filter api start:prod"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @monorepo/config typecheck && pnpm --filter @monorepo/constants typecheck && pnpm --filter @monorepo/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @monorepo/database typecheck && pnpm --filter @monorepo/queues typecheck && pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter api typecheck
